title: Load plugins and settings explicitly if claude -p goes bare by default
goal: _tools/agent_bench.py configs that rely on the clone's plugins and settings load them explicitly, so a bare claude -p runs them unchanged (_tools/kb_ask.py already passes its servers). Tests named agent_bench_bare prove each such config passes its plugins and settings explicitly.

trigger.when: --bare becomes the default for claude -p (Claude Code release notes or the headless docs say so)
